title: Bike Portal Historical Master List
scope: Historical brand/model reference for designing and testing future ingestion methods. US availability is not an acceptance criterion for this release.
acceptance: The canonical file has no exact normalized brand/model duplicates.
Every retained original source pair is represented, and confirmed exclusions are recoverable.
Catalog-reported years remain source-provenanced and are not expanded into inferred ranges.
Frame/module candidates remain visible and flagged unless source-confirmed for exclusion; all exclusions remain recoverable.
Model source status distinguishes official model evidence, unverified catalog links and blanks.
Photo URLs are pinned-source catalog references, with all variants and source provenance retained.
User-provided BikeBook archive details are matched exactly by normalized brand/model/year; manufacturer URLs and catalog-photo URLs remain source references with archive SHA-256 provenance.
non_claims: This is the project official working list, not an assertion that every row is manufacturer-official or globally complete.
This release does not verify legal manufacturer entity, complete-bike status, trim parsing, type, model year, or production coverage for every row.
This release does not authorize database ingestion, public display, deployment, or reuse beyond the applicable source-license review.
Photo URLs are not downloaded image assets, an accessibility guarantee, or a license to hotlink, reproduce or publish images.
The archive did not supply a reliable type, legal manufacturer entity, or distinct trim field, so none are inferred from component descriptions or filenames.
source_and_rights: See source-assessment.json and BIKEBOOK-LICENSE.txt. BikeBook provenance is retained; downstream rights review is required before any production data use.
